description: Resources no longer fail to start after a timed-out or HTTP 504 DCP create that the server actually committed. AppHost now checks for an existing resource before retrying, with configurable `KubernetesApiTimeout`, `KubernetesInitializationAdditionalTimeout`, and `KubernetesCreateRecoveryTimeout` settings for slower environments.
name: Recover ambiguous DCP creates with configurable timeouts
